examples.title: Sanitized HTML Content
examples.description: Rendering user-generated HTML content safely with XSS prevention
examples.note: Always sanitize user-generated HTML before rendering

examples.title: Secure Form Input
examples.description: Form input with client-side validation and server-side sanitization
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="username">Username</Label>
  <Textfield 
    id="username"
    data-size="medium"
    pattern="[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,20}"
    maxLength={20}
    onChange={(e) => {
      // Client-side: restrict input
      const value = e.target.value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '');
      setValue(value);
    }}
  />
  <Text variant="caption" size="xs">
    Only letters, numbers, and underscores allowed
  </Text>
</Stack>
examples.note: Always validate and sanitize on server-side as well

examples.title: Secure File Upload
examples.description: File upload with type and size validation
examples.code:
<FileUploader
  accept=".pdf,.doc,.docx"
  maxSize={5 * 1024 * 1024}
  onFileSelect={(file) => {
    // Validate file type
    const allowedTypes = ['application/pdf', 'application/msword'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      setError('Invalid file type');
      return;
    }
    // Validate file size
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setError('File too large');
      return;
    }
    handleUpload(file);
  }}
  error={error}
/>
examples.note: Always validate file type and size on server-side

examples.title: Secure Link
examples.description: Link component that prevents javascript: protocol
examples.code:
<Link 
  href={sanitizedUrl}
  rel="noopener noreferrer"
  target="_blank"
>
  External Link
</Link>
examples.note: Always sanitize URLs and use rel="noopener noreferrer" for external links

examples.title: Secure Password Input
examples.description: Password input with strength indicator and security best practices
examples.code:
<Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
  <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
  <Textfield
    id="password"
    type="password"
    data-size="medium"
    autoComplete="new-password"
    aria-describedby="password-requirements"
  />
  <Text variant="caption" size="xs" id="password-requirements">
    Must be at least 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and number
  </Text>
</Stack>
examples.note: Use autoComplete="new-password" to prevent password manager conflicts

examples.title: Form with CSRF Token
examples.description: Form including CSRF token field (token provided by platform)
examples.code:
<form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <input type="hidden" name="csrfToken" value={csrfToken} />
  <Stack direction="vertical" gap="md">
    <Stack direction="vertical" gap="xs">
      <Label htmlFor="name">Name</Label>
      <Textfield id="name" data-size="medium" name="name" />
    </Stack>
    <Button type="submit" data-color="accent">Submit</Button>
  </Stack>
</form>
examples.note: CSRF token provided by platform package, UI only displays it
